title: Hazratganj Market, Lucknow - The Heart of Shopping & Culture
content:
Hazratganj Market, Lucknow

Hazratganj Market is the most famous and lively shopping area in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Known as the commercial and cultural hub of the city, Hazratganj beautifully blends colonial charm with modern lifestyle. From branded showrooms and traditional shops to cafés, bookstores, and cinemas, Hazratganj offers something for everyone.

Established during the British era, Hazratganj has evolved into a vibrant boulevard where history meets contemporary city life. Whether you are a shopper, foodie, or just a traveler exploring Lucknow, a walk through Hazratganj is an experience in itself.

History of Hazratganj

Hazratganj was developed in the early 19th century under British rule as a central marketplace for the city’s elite. Over time, it became the main commercial street of Lucknow. The name “Hazratganj” is believed to be derived from a respected local saint, giving the area both historical and cultural importance.

Even today, the wide roads, colonial-style buildings, and old shops reflect its heritage while modern malls and stores show its changing face.

Shopping in Hazratganj

Hazratganj is a paradise for shoppers. You can find everything here - from luxury brands to affordable local products.

What to Buy:

  • Chikankari clothes - Lucknow’s famous hand embroidery
  • Traditional jewelry & bangles
  • Perfumes (ittar) from local shops
  • Books & stationery
  • Footwear, bags, and souvenirs

Popular spots include Janpath Market, Sahara Ganj Mall, and many roadside stalls offering great bargains.

Food & Cafés in Hazratganj

Hazratganj is equally loved for its food scene. From legendary eateries to modern cafés, food lovers are spoilt for choice.

Must-Try Places:

  • Royal Café - famous for basket chaat
  • Marksmen & Capoor & Sons - for snacks and sweets
  • Café Coffee Day, Starbucks - for coffee lovers
  • Local street food - chaat, momos, kulfi, and kebabs nearby

Don’t miss tasting Lucknowi chaat and kebabs while you are here.

Entertainment & Hangout Spots

Hazratganj is also a favorite hangout place for locals.

  • Inox & SRS Cinemas - for movies
  • Parks & open spaces - to relax and people-watch
  • Evening walks - the area comes alive after sunset

The beautifully lit streets in the evening make it a perfect place for photos and casual strolls.

Location & How to Reach

Hazratganj is located in the center of Lucknow city.

  • By Metro: Hazratganj Metro Station
  • By Road: Easily accessible by auto, cab, and buses
  • From Airport: About 15 km

From Charbagh Railway Station: Around 4–5 km

Best Time to Visit

  • October to March: Pleasant weather for shopping and walking
  • Evenings (5 PM - 9 PM): Best time to enjoy lights, food, and crowd
  • Weekends: Lively but crowded

Nearby Places to Visit

  • Aminabad Market - traditional bazaar
  • Residency, Lucknow - 1857 revolt site
  • Bara Imambara & Rumi Darwaza - heritage monuments
  • Gomti Riverfront - evening leisure spot
  • Ambedkar Memorial Park

Why Visit Hazratganj Market?

Hazratganj is not just a shopping street - it is the soul of modern Lucknow. It shows the city’s polite culture, relaxed lifestyle, and love for food and fashion. A visit here lets you experience both old-world charm and today’s urban energy.
